label: Non-negotiables (practice integrity)

load_bearing.rule: One liberal art per experiment / block
load_bearing.why: Flores Aurei §68; Skinner Version B practice guide
Notoria structure: generals strengthen the mind that runs the art

load_bearing.rule: Contemplate ONE nota / visual object — not a wall of notes
Study the art immediately after the rite
load_bearing.why: Prayer supports learning; it does not replace it

load_bearing.rule: Log what stuck / what scattered before leaving
Stop / return always available in any linked shell

historical_optional.rule: Historical: chastity + avoid mortal sin during work
historical_optional.modern_ok: clear head · no intoxicants for the sitting · good faith

historical_optional.soft_clause: good will counts if full penitence not possible

historical_optional.rule: Version B Phase 2: saffron-rosewater / angel-name water
historical_optional.substitute: pure water or skip; Bonitatem optional

historical_optional.rule: Historical Version B: angel dream permission before month 1
historical_optional.modern_treat: optional narrative layer — not a gate for study practice

never_claim: that modern copyrighted prayers can be redistributed
